title: Choose a wedge and acquisition channel for clinic software
scenario:
TOPIC: Find a demand wedge for clinic follow-up software
A founder says the target is 'all doctors' and plans to use content, paid search, LinkedIn, and influencers at once. The product automates post-visit follow-up; no customer has paid yet. The launch budget is ₹75,000 and the target price is ₹10,000 per clinic per month. Challenge the demand and positioning assumptions, narrow the target to a testable customer, name the current alternative and switching reason, choose one channel with lead-to-close arithmetic and payback, state what behavior would prove demand, and end with a proven / plausible / imagined verdict.

expected_elements.name: demand and positioning objections
expected_elements.pattern: demand (?:&|and) positioning objections?\s*:|missing evidence|what would prove

expected_elements.name: one channel hypothesis
expected_elements.pattern: strongest channel|one channel|direct outreach|paid search|cold outreach

improvement_suggestions: Replace the broad audience with one observable buyer profile.
Choose a single route to buyers and show its full economic chain.
Define a real commitment that separates interest from demand.
